title: Page-fit result
description: out/<run-slug>/fit.json. Written by `cvt fit`. Records the density preset and the dropped tailored IDs chosen by the monotone search, so `cvt render` reproduces the exact fitted output without re-searching.

tailored_version.description: tailored.json version this fit applies to; render refuses a stale fit.

pages.description: Page count of the fitted render.

dropped_ids.description: Tailored bullet/cert/skill-group IDs removed to fit, in drop order.

underfilled.description: true when all content fits in fewer pages than page_target (reported, not auto-padded).
